title: Store Plan Lookback Bonus on FBN Warehouse-Loss Claims
content:
*Training note for the reimbursement desk, Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN).*

A store lookback bonus is added to the lookback base to give the warehouse-loss lookback: the large store bonus of 2 months when the seller's selling plan is Anchor Store or Enterprise Store and was opened at least the store tenure threshold of 12 whole months before the handling date, the small store bonus of 1 month when the selling plan is Basic Store or Premium Store opened at least that threshold of 12 whole months before, and no bonus (0 months) for any other selling plan or a plan opened more recently.

The seller's selling plan is read from the seller's Selling Plans record: the plan name and the date the plan was opened. Whole months run from that opened date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month.

## Questions this note answers

**Which plans earn the 2-month bonus?** Anchor Store and Enterprise Store, opened 12 whole months or more before the handling date.

**Which plans earn the 1-month bonus?** Basic Store and Premium Store, opened 12 whole months or more before the handling date.

**What does an Anchor Store opened 11 whole months ago earn?** No bonus: the plan was opened more recently than the 12-month threshold.

**What does a seller on any other selling plan earn, however long held?** No bonus: 0 months.

**How is the bonus used?** It is added to the lookback base; the sum is the warehouse-loss lookback for the claim.

## Bonus by plan and age (hypothetical sellers)

| Selling Plans plan | Opened, whole months before the handling date | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Enterprise Store | 12 | 2 months |
| Enterprise Store | 11 | 0 months |
| Premium Store | 18 | 1 month |
| Basic Store | 5 | 0 months |
| any other selling plan | 60 | 0 months |

Example (hypothetical): for a seller whose Anchor Store plan was opened 26 whole months before the handling date, 2 months are added to the lookback base; for a seller whose Basic Store plan was opened 3 whole months before, nothing is added.
